purpose: Create a low-cost append-only record of immutable AlphaDojo stock and benchmark source vintages observed prospectively, without repeatedly downloading the full parquet datasets or evaluating outcomes.

repositories.role: stock factor history and D/T economic endpoints

capture_identity.observation_time: Runner wall-clock time is descriptive only. The GitHub committed_at timestamp of the capture-file creation commit is the authoritative repository observation time.
capture_identity.immutability: A capture receipt is never overwritten. A new receipt is created only when at least one tracked repository revision/LFS identity differs from the latest frozen receipt.

storage.receipt_format: one JSON file per new source-identity tuple
storage.reason: Delete repeated ~300MB downloads from the routine capture path. Immutable commit/LFS identity is enough to materialize the exact vintage later if and only if it is needed.

later_materialization_gate: Materialize the exact frozen revision before confirmatory use.
Verify downloaded bytes against the frozen LFS SHA256.
Verify stock/benchmark bar coverage and source max_bar_date for the candidate signal date.
Reject source vintages that violate the frozen V2.8.3 signal-date/source-cutoff rules.
prospective_use.outcome_rule: D and T economic endpoints for an evaluated signal date must come from the same retained T-vintage snapshot.
prospective_use.no_backfill_claim: A later source pin cannot be relabeled as if it had been observed before its authoritative GitHub commit timestamp.

capture_policy.future_schedule: Requires a separate activation record defining cadence and cutoff semantics.

forbidden: Do not modify V2.8.1/V2.8.2 results from source-ledger observations.
Do not compute interim H1/H2 PASS/FAIL during source capture.
Do not change V2.8.3 hypothesis thresholds or boundaries from captured source content.
Do not treat source metadata capture as proof that max_bar_date equals a signal date until exact vintage materialization verifies it.
